IMO: What is happening to the crypto market? 

A napkin Sketch Science Fiction take with a grain of salt. 

There has been a regime change in the crypto market. This is why Clarity was not passed, for this event. The market is being reset and will be rebuilt on regulated infrastructure. This event is a precursor to what will happen to the stock market when it is reset onto the DTC tokenization infrastructure. Crypto always leads. The entire derivative stack is being unwound and rebuilt on the new system. AI is being used not by hackers, but by incumbants, the controllers, who can now forceably apply their will using frontier models we dont have access to. 

Possible Hyperliquid and regulated exchanges like Coinbase take the book. 

Ive lived through 3 market regime changes, this is how they look.

Positive Take: This is good news for spot holders with no intention of selling until 2030. This is long term stability, store of value, removal of artificial volatility.  As I said regime change transition is chaotic. It is uncomfortable. This is that feeling. We asked for regulation, this is how it is installed.

Our world is at a turning point, and like every turning point in history, the people living through it don’t know it yet.

In 1937, Berliners still went to work every morning.

I‘m not saying WW3. But I do think we’re at the start of a global reengineering. Things are breaking one after another, and Earth Online just loaded its next main quest:

THE GREAT REPRICING.

The economy gets worse from here. By the end of 2027, this week will feel like a light tickle.

A lot of people are scared, and I understand why. But I‘m very, very, VERY excited. And you should be too.

If you’ve spent years feeling late to everything, priced out of the house, late to Bitcoin, late to AI, watching the same people win every round while you did everything “right”, there‘s a reason.

In calm times, whoever already has money and access just keeps compounding, and working harder rarely gets you a seat.

Chaos is when the seats open back up.

I bought my first Bitcoin in 2013, when most people had never heard of it. At the time I had no idea how insanely big it would become. It felt risky and even a little embarrassing to explain.

By the time it felt obvious, the cheap seats were gone. I can feel that same kind of moment starting again.

If you’ve ever really loved someone, you know the fastest way to hate a person is to love them first. Nobody else can hurt you that deeply, because nobody else ever got that close.

Disaster and opportunity live that close too, and most people only find out which one they were holding after it‘s gone.

Stagflation gave us Microsoft and Apple. The Great Depression gave us HP. The 2008 crash gave us Airbnb, Uber and Bitcoin.

While the world was locked inside during the pandemic, OpenAI released GPT-3 and Anthropic was founded. Every one of them made its move while everyone else was scared.

In more than a decade of trading, I’ve been liquidated three times. Each time I was sure it was the end of me. And each time, I came back stronger in every way that counts, including my account. I made back far more than I ever lost. If I had believed those moments were the end, the person writing this wouldn‘t exist.

Now the whole world is heading into its own version of that moment.

And I don’t think this window stays open long. My guess is about two years. Building at the frontier already takes billions of dollars of compute, and whoever owns the models, the chips, and the data gets stronger every quarter.

As AI keeps compounding for the people who already control it, the wall around them gets taller, and no amount of talent gets you over it.

Maybe I‘m wrong about how fast, and it’s four or five years instead of two. But I‘d bet this is one of the last big reshuffles in the next few decades where an outsider can still break in.

So use it. If you can build, build.

If you don’t know how to build, get your ass off that bed and learn, because in this era anyone can.

If you trade, keep cash ready, stay patient, and buy when everyone else is desperate to sell. And if you short, do it carefully, because no bear market only goes down and the bounces are brutal. Or do both. There‘s still time to get that cash ready.

Every disaster has a door in it.

Most people only see the fire.

METR spent almost three months inside Anthropic and concluded that Anthropic is now improving its new models about twice as fast as it did between March 2024 and October 2025. 

The summary of the report, “Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026,” says it all:

“As of October 2026, Anthropic is likely improving the capabilities of their models on well-specified tasks at around twice the rate they did between March 2024 and October 2025. This estimate is given with high uncertainty; we would not be surprised if the true acceleration was closer to 1.3x or 3x the historical rate.”

AI that speeds up the development of AI is the feedback loop behind every model of an intelligence explosion.
